title: the council did not pass after 3 rounds
details:
- [major] video-coverage-1 (sol) BRAND-2 video coverage remains incomplete: Run E2E_KEEP_VIDEOS=1 npx playwright test -c playwright.teststack.config.ts brand-2 on the test stack, keep the passing TC-BRAND-2-09 and TC-BRAND-2-10 webm files under artifacts/e2e-videos/scenarios beside the epic recordings, and describe them in the PR records.
- [major] video-coverage-2 (sol) BRAND-3 direct-link and fallback videos remain missing: Run the brand-3 spec with E2E_KEEP_VIDEOS=1 and keep and attach the passing TC-BRAND-3-10, -11 and -12 videos.
- [major] VID-2-2 (sol) BRAND-1 singular, empty-card and item-page videos remain missing: Run the brand-1 spec with E2E_KEEP_VIDEOS=1 and keep and attach the passing TC-BRAND-1-05, -08 and -09 videos.
- [minor] OPUS-3-1 (opus) Two helpers read the summary response in BrandSummaryTests: Make GetSummaryAsync delegate to GetAsync(SummaryUrl) and ParseBrands, or remove it and use those helpers in TC_BRAND_1_01..03; use IdAndBrand at line 78.
